ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee to the rider
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the complaint ("He never called me"), the driver's statement and the chat logs contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark, dangerous-driving or accident allegation. safety_concern = none; no escalation on that ground.

The dispute is a $5.00 rider-no-show cancellation fee, so NS-0/NS-1 govern. Testing the NS-1 conditions on the record:
(i) Arrival — the driver pressed arrival (app event "driver_arrived" 22:39:00) and his GPS fixes at 22:39:00 (1.28379, 103.851009) and at 22:39:30 (1.283779, 103.85102) are within ~85–95 m of the Raffles Place pickup (1.284, 103.8513), i.e. inside the 200 m radius. Met.
(ii) Free wait — 5 minutes counted from the later of scheduled pickup and arrival (arrival 22:39; no other scheduled time in the record), so the wait expired at 22:44. The driver cancelled at 22:45, i.e. one minute past the wait. Met (no record no-show threshold applies).
(iii) Contact before cancelling — NS-1 requires ≥ 1 in-app message AND ≥ 1 in-app call. There are no call records at all in this case file, and the driver's own statement admits it: "I messaged the rider in the app; I did not call." Only two chat messages exist (22:39:30 and 22:44:50); no call was ever placed. Not met.
(iv) Continuous presence — the thinned GPS track shows the vehicle stationary on D'Almeida Street from 22:39:00 to 22:45:00 with no gap (the thinning note explains the sample interval), so presence is proven. Met.

Because condition (iii) fails, NS-1 does not hold and NS-2 applies: the cancellation fee is voided and the rider is not charged. Refund = the full $5.00 cancellation fee (refund_full), the fixed no-show amount per TH-2 (no-show/cancellation is a system-final category). No flag_account: the driver did mark arrival while genuinely at the pickup point, so the NS-2 flag trigger (arrival marked away from pickup) is absent, and neither party carries a fraud flag. Precedent DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel, zero contact, $5.00) points the same way.

element_findings.element: Driver arrival at pickup within 200 m (NS-1(i))
element_findings.reason: Arrival was marked at 22:39:00 and the driver's GPS fixes then were ~85–95 m from the Raffles Place pickup point (1.284, 103.8513), inside the 200 m radius.
Wait counted from the later of scheduled pickup and arrival (22:39); the driver cancelled at 22:45, one minute after the wait expired.

element_findings.element: Pre-cancellation contact: ≥1 in-app message AND ≥1 in-app call (NS-1(iii))
basis: driver_statement: 'I messaged the rider in the app; I did not call.'
no call records in case file
element_findings.reason: Two in-app messages were sent, but no in-app call was ever made — the driver admits this and the record contains no call logs. The conjunctive NS-1 condition therefore fails.

element_findings.element: Driver remained at the pickup point throughout (NS-1(iv))
basis: gps 22:39:00–22:45:00 on D'ALMEIDA STREET, speed ~0–2 km/h, no gap
element_findings.reason: The thinned track shows the vehicle effectively stationary at the pickup across the whole wait with no GPS gap; thinning (every 6th sample) explains the sampling interval.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's claim to have completed the no-show procedure is contradicted by his own admission that he did not call and by the absence of any in-app call record; NS-1 requires both a message and a call before cancelling.
